review: 701.36a-1: the only does_not_fire variant was Negate countering the spell, a counterspell mechanism rather than populate; replaced it with B controlling the Soldier token (populate copies only a creature token you control) and dropped Negate and the Islands
701.36b-1: decisions said A chooses a creature token A controls, which does not exist in the base; reworded to choose one only if there is one

scenarios.title: Populate creates a copy of a creature token the controller controls

setup.notes: The Soldier token is a white 1/1 Soldier creature token. Grizzly Bears is a nontoken creature. In the two_kinds variant the Wolf is a green 2/2 Wolf creature token.

decisions: A casts Rootborn Defenses, tapping three Plains.
Both players pass; it resolves and A populates, choosing the Soldier token.

variants.label: one_token
variants.expected: A controls two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens (the new one is a copy of the old). Rootborn Defenses is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: counter_on_token
variants.delta: The Soldier token has one +1/+1 counter.
variants.expected: A controls a 2/2 Soldier token with the counter and a new 1/1 Soldier token without a counter.

variants.label: opponent_controls_token
variants.delta: B controls the Soldier token instead of A.
variants.expected: No token is created. B controls the one Soldier token; A controls Grizzly Bears. Rootborn Defenses resolves and is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: two_kinds
variants.delta: A also controls a 2/2 green Wolf token, and A chooses the Wolf.
variants.expected: A controls the Soldier token, the Wolf token and a new 2/2 green Wolf token.

scenarios.title: Populate with no creature token to copy creates no token

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears is a nontoken creature. The Soldier token is a white 1/1 Soldier creature token.

decisions: A casts Rootborn Defenses, tapping three Plains.
Both players pass; it resolves and A populates, choosing a creature token A controls if there is one.

variants.label: no_tokens
variants.expected: A controls only Grizzly Bears; no token is created. Rootborn Defenses resolves and is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: treasure_only
variants.delta: A controls a Treasure token (an artifact, not a creature).
variants.expected: No token is created; A controls Grizzly Bears and the Treasure token.

variants.label: opponent_token
variants.delta: B controls a Soldier creature token.
variants.expected: No token is created for A: populate copies only a creature token its controller controls.

variants.label: creature_token
variants.delta: A controls a Soldier creature token.
variants.expected: A creates a new 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
